rationale: Adds a second model backend behind the agent seam, which is a new top-level subsystem by the codebase's own structure: three new src modules mirroring the OpenCode split (claude-connect.ts for spawning/addressing the CLI, claude-contract.ts for the recorded Zod-decoded stream-json NDJSON, claude-adapter.ts for the session with process-group abort and exit-code discipline), plus a credential-guard module (exactly-one-of ANTHROPIC_API_KEY / CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN; may fold into secrets.ts). Existing modules are touched only at the seam's edges: contain.ts hardwires createOpenCodeAgent + startProviderProxy today and becomes the AGENT_BACKEND selector (claude route skips the provider-proxy/openai-config path entirely); agent-handle.ts types the memoized session as OpenCodeAgent and needs a backend-neutral interface; config.ts / config-model-values.ts gain AGENT_BACKEND (default opencode) and stop requiring LLM_* endpoint vars on the claude route where knobs map to --model/--effort; secrets.ts keeps the scrub and injects only the chosen credential; permissions.ts holds the deny-by-default profiles that must map to --allowedTools; errors.ts gains distinguishable codes for guard failure and non-zero CLI exit; turn-run.ts's TurnConnection/TurnBounds slices and failure classification must hold for a backend with no long-lived server; index.ts owns startup order and teardown. Workflow change is one conditional pinned claude-CLI install step in agent-pipeline.yml, pinned by workflow.test.ts. Tests: new claude adapter/contract suite with fixtures recorded from a live CLI (plus a live recorder akin to live-sdk.integration.ts) and config-values tests for the new knob. No DB/state-block changes, no papai src/ changes; review-loop's own `opencode run` backend is a recorded residual, untouched. cross_module=true (src modules + workflow + tests + docs), provider_surface=true (a model backend is the provider surface), credentials=true (exclusivity guard, env scrub, single-credential injection).
